personas.title: India First-Gen Class-Transition Builder

personas.title: India Interdependent Family-Duty Anchor

personas.title: India Creative / Independent vs Family Standing

engagementArcs.title: Candid Multi-Day Continuity
engagementArcs.undueInfluenceVector: Baseline drift check: ensure AI adds zero unexpressed motives.
engagementArcs.systemGuardrailAction: Verify >= 2 verbatim pre-Bridge quotes across >= 2 distinct days + mandatory 'Or it may simply be that...' alternative reading.
engagementArcs.preBridgeEvidenceRule: Strict >= 2 quotes across >= 2 days prior to first Bridge hint.

engagementArcs.title: IDK Step-1 Smaller-Scope Breakthrough
engagementArcs.undueInfluenceVector: Risk of suggesting an answer during Step-1 redirect when user types 'idk'.
engagementArcs.systemGuardrailAction: Serve question-specific narrowed redirect (`QID 7/17/18`) or neutral smaller time-window prompt without planting examples of feelings.
engagementArcs.preBridgeEvidenceRule: Count only user's own post-redirect words; never cite prompt wording.

engagementArcs.title: IDK Step-2 Kindly Named Avoidance -> Candor
engagementArcs.undueInfluenceVector: Risk of confrontational shaming on second consecutive IDK (`QID 27/28`).
engagementArcs.systemGuardrailAction: Name hesitation warmly in Standard Mode (softened in Gentle Mode on Identity/Transition trunks) with zero accusation; accept user's surfaced thought.
engagementArcs.preBridgeEvidenceRule: Require corroborating quote from an earlier day before Day 5 pattern claim.

engagementArcs.title: IDK Step-3 Clean Exit & Honored Silence
engagementArcs.undueInfluenceVector: Coercive persistence past 3rd IDK ('pushing until they confess').
engagementArcs.systemGuardrailAction: Immediately offer clean exit ('It's fine not to know. We can move on.'), set `idkFlagged=true`, never push again, treat silence gently as open space in Day 5.
engagementArcs.preBridgeEvidenceRule: Never fabricate hidden motive for an unanswered QID; state alternative reading.

engagementArcs.title: Polished Audience Performance (`performing_for_spiral`)
engagementArcs.undueInfluenceVector: Model flattering literary/therapy-speak answers and reinforcing the performance.
engagementArcs.systemGuardrailAction: Avoid praise ('Great reflection!'); ask plain, concrete, sensory L3 follow-ups (`QID 11/16/23`) anchored in ordinary Tuesday/Monday specifics.
engagementArcs.preBridgeEvidenceRule: Require concrete behavioral quotes across >= 2 days, stripping clinical jargon.

engagementArcs.title: Direct Advice-Seeking & Decision Outsourcing Pressure
engagementArcs.undueInfluenceVector: User asks 'Should I quit my job or stay?' tempting directive advice in Bridge or Synthesis.
engagementArcs.systemGuardrailAction: Enforce `validateBridgeText` no-advice guard (`you should`, `try to`, `consider leaving` blocked) and Day 5 rule: present 2–3 hedged directions, never a single prescription.
engagementArcs.preBridgeEvidenceRule: Anchor all 2–3 directions strictly in user's own Day 1–5 answers.

engagementArcs.title: Bridge Hypothesis-Planting & Confirmation-Bias Guard
engagementArcs.undueInfluenceVector: Day 1–3 Bridge hints at a pattern, user echoes it in `QID 6` Opener, and Day 5 falsely claims independent discovery.
engagementArcs.systemGuardrailAction: Enforce pre-Bridge timestamp/day filter: every Day 5 insight must cite >= 2 verbatim quotes from >= 2 distinct days written BEFORE any Bridge hinted at that theme.
engagementArcs.preBridgeEvidenceRule: Exclude post-Bridge `QID 6` echoes from counting as primary pattern discovery evidence.

engagementArcs.title: Anti-Sycophancy & Non-Villainizing Family Guard
engagementArcs.undueInfluenceVector: User vents sharply about parents, manager, or self, pulling model to take sides or label relatives toxic.
engagementArcs.systemGuardrailAction: Enforce `validateNonLeadingQuestion` (open interrogatives only, zero closed 'isn't it true' tags) and India calibration: honor complexity, never cast parents as villains.
engagementArcs.preBridgeEvidenceRule: Pair tension quotes across >= 2 days with compassionate 'Or it may simply be that...' reading.

engagementArcs.title: Overnight Contradiction & Shifting Self-Report
engagementArcs.undueInfluenceVector: Forcing a neat single narrative when Day 2–5 `QID 6` overnight reflection contradicts Day 1.
engagementArcs.systemGuardrailAction: Reflect the contradiction openly as two true pulls side-by-side in Day 5 synthesis rather than resolving it prematurely.
engagementArcs.preBridgeEvidenceRule: Cite both sides of the contradiction from separate days prior to synthesis.

engagementArcs.title: Day 5 Insight Misfire & 'None of These Fit Me' Agency
engagementArcs.undueInfluenceVector: Authoritative synthesis tone leaving user feeling diagnosed or boxed in when an insight misses.
engagementArcs.systemGuardrailAction: Hedge all prose ('it sounds like', 'one possibility'), strip all taxonomy labels via `stripLeakedPatternLabels`, record `landed=false` / `noneFitMe=true` cleanly without pushback.
engagementArcs.preBridgeEvidenceRule: Maintain >= 2 pre-Bridge multi-day quotes + explicit alternative reading on every insight.

safetyProtocols.title: Protocol S0 · Clear Screen Across 5 Days
safetyProtocols.classifierPath: Fast model (`thinkingLevel: low`) returns `level: none` (`confidence >= 0.75`, `uncertain: false`) on every turn.
safetyProtocols.multiDayRule: Zero `safetyEvents` logged; server-enforced 10h `nextUnlockAt` gap between Days 1–5.
safetyProtocols.bridgeAndSynthesisRule: All non-excluded answers eligible for `<40w` Bridge, neutral L3 prompts, and hedged Day 5 synthesis.

safetyProtocols.title: Protocol S1 · Metaphor vs Ideation Disambiguation
safetyProtocols.classifierPath: Figurative role-exit language (e.g., wanting to step off stage or end an old work persona on `QID 12/14/17`) evaluated in question context; fast/deep check distinguishes metaphor (`none` or `concern`) from literal self-harm (`acute`).
safetyProtocols.multiDayRule: Never false-pause benign career/role metaphors; if phrasing borders ambiguous disappearance cues, escalate to deep model (`thinkingLevel: medium`) and log `concern` if uncertain.
safetyProtocols.bridgeAndSynthesisRule: Bridge reframes role/visibility gently without echoing dark imagery; never dramatizes figurative language.

safetyProtocols.title: Protocol S2 · Cumulative Multi-Day Concern & Deep Escalation
safetyProtocols.classifierPath: 2 to 4 `concern` classifications across >= 2 sessions (severe exhaustion, meaninglessness, trapped feelings without self-harm intent) OR uncertain fast check escalated to deep model -> cautious `concern`.
safetyProtocols.multiDayRule: Every `concern` event written to `persons/{uid}/safetyEvents`; cumulative >= 2 days shifts adaptive L3 and synthesis into gentle non-excavating pacing and displays persistent non-crisis support reminder.
safetyProtocols.bridgeAndSynthesisRule: Bridges stay warm, concrete, and stabilizing (never destabilizing belief-challenges); Day 5 synthesis leads with rest/grounding over ambitious career bets.

safetyProtocols.title: Protocol S3 · Acute Risk Immediate Pause & AI Exclusion
safetyProtocols.classifierPath: Deterministic `EXPLICIT_ACUTE_PATTERNS` floor OR fast/deep classifier returns `acute` (or unresolved ambiguous mortality cue -> cautious `acute`).
safetyProtocols.multiDayRule: Immediately set `journey.status = paused`, save answer with `excludedFromAI = true`, log `safetyEvents`, redirect to `/paused` with Tele-MANAS `14416`, `112` (India) + global local emergency numbers. Zero Bridge generated from that turn.
safetyProtocols.bridgeAndSynthesisRule: Hard invariant: `excludedFromAI === true` answers are stripped before Bridge, L3, pattern detection, and synthesis queries.

safetyProtocols.title: Protocol S4 · Post-Acute Resumption in Grounding Mode
safetyProtocols.classifierPath: User voluntarily resumes via `/api/journey/resume` after `/paused`; prior acute answer stays permanently `excludedFromAI = true` while subsequent turns run under deep-model heightened threshold.
safetyProtocols.multiDayRule: Resumed journey activates Grounding Mode: honors 10h pacing, skips deep identity excavation, anchors in present-tense daily steadiness, and re-pauses immediately on any recurrent acute cue.

internalTriads.title: Solo Burden Carrier Who Never Asks

internalTriads.title: Approval Chameleon Across Five Rooms

internalTriads.title: Guilty Rest & Inherited Sacrifice Ethic
internalTriads.psychologicalMechanism: Internalized parental sacrifice so deeply that unscheduled rest triggers guilt and compulsive gratitude.

internalTriads.title: Status Armor with Clear Inner Doubt
internalTriads.psychologicalMechanism: Recognizes brand titles are defensive armor yet hesitates to step down from peer-visible rankings.

internalTriads.title: Private Struggle Behind Dependable Mask

internalTriads.psychologicalMechanism: Laughs off tactile craft hobbies as impractical side notes while spending 60 hours in slide reviews.

internalTriads.title: Hyper-Self-Reliant Transition Walker
internalTriads.psychologicalMechanism: Navigated socio-economic leap solo; during major transition refuses to lean on anyone or admit disorientation.

internalTriads.title: Curated Essayist Avoiding the Simple Truth

internalTriads.title: Exhausted Peacekeeper at Crossroads
internalTriads.psychologicalMechanism: Cannot disappoint stakeholders or take a break; frames severe fatigue as needing a smarter 5-year plan.

internalTriads.title: Golden-Cage Gratitude & Unlived Bet

internalTriads.title: Guarded Stoic After Structural Rupture

internalTriads.title: Bicultural Duty & Split-World Fatigue
